description: Bench Coach helps youth, travel, high-school, and college-adjacent baseball coaches turn real coaching questions into practical next steps. It provides focused workflows for age-tier fundamentals, practice planning, postgame analysis from coach-provided GameChanger exports or screenshots, lineups and defense, pitch sequencing, visual teach boards, parent communication, and player development.

defaultPrompt: Plan a 75-minute 10U baseball practice for 11 players, two coaches, and one batting cage.
Turn this GameChanger box score into a calm postgame review with three next-practice priorities.
Create a simple teach-board sequence for first-and-third defense that I can explain to 12U players.
